## Is this related to a problem?

A clear description of what the problem is. Ex. "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Which devices would this affect?

- [ ] Kiosk (Raspberry Pi touchscreen)
- [ ] Mobile (phone browser)
- [ ] Desktop (browser)
- [ ] All devices

## Additional context

Add any mockups, screenshots, or additional context here.

## Have you checked FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md?

- [ ] Yes, this feature is not already planned
- [ ] Yes, this feature is planned but I have additional input
